Texas Longhorns climb to No. 1 in AP college football poll

The Texas Longhorns have risen to the No. 1 spot in the Associated Press college football poll following a comeback victory over the Ohio State Buckeyes. Ohio State, previously ranked No. 1, dropped in the rankings, as did Oregon. Michigan re-entered the Top 25. Arch Manning was highlighted for his role in Texas's rally. The game between Texas and Ohio State was described as a significant collision between college football powerhouses.
